meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 在宿主机安装 rtk 并只读挂载进容器,再通过 PreToolUse 钩子把每次 Bash 调用自动经 rtk 过滤,在 git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令上节省 60–90% token。
howto.when: 当你要求给某个 agent group 安装或接入 rtk 时触发;流程依次是宿主机安装、挂载进容器、写钩子、重启容器。

say.text: 给这个 agent group 装好 rtk 并重启容器
say.note: 会依次做安装、挂载、写钩子、重启

say.text: 用 add-mount 把 rtk 挂进 ag-xxx 的容器
跑 rtk gain 看看省了多少 token
say.note: 输出 token 节省统计

howto.what_en: Installs the rtk proxy on the host and mounts it read-only into agent containers, then adds a PreToolUse hook so every Bash call is filtered through rtk, saving 60-90% tokens on dev commands like git, cargo and pytest.
howto.when_en: Runs when you ask to install or wire rtk into an agent group; the skill then walks through host install, container mount, hook write and container restart.

say_en.text: Install rtk for this agent group and restart the container
say_en.note: Installs, mounts, writes the hook, then restarts

say_en.text: Mount rtk into ag-xxx's container with add-mount
Run rtk gain to see the token savings
